title: Romanze
identity: Max Reger’s Romanze is available in a specific alto-saxophone/piano-or-organ transcription by Trent Kynaston, Advance Music 7054; Schott also lists a separate tenor-saxophone-in-B-flat edition, 7055. A retailer identifies the alto transcription’s original as a piano/violin work in G major, WoO II/10; that provenance detail remains retailer-sourced.

evidence.claim: Listing identifies Kynaston as transcriber, original violin/piano setting and the six-page Advance Music edition.

Schott’s Classics for Saxophone catalog lists Reger’s Romanze transcribed by Trent Kynaston in separate alto-saxophone/piano-or-organ (ADV 7054) and tenor-saxophone-in-B-flat/piano-or-organ (ADV 7055) editions.
